statement: In the fixed 12-target DepMap pilot, 4 one-feature rules passed the prespecified internal screening gates. The prospective biology-pair contribution failed its primary held-out improvement gate (normalized MSE skill -0.005984). No novel biological relationship or robust external biomarker confirmation is established.
status: Completed local computational pilot; author-checked, not scientifically accepted; donor intake closed pending maintainer.
scope: 967 annotated cancer-model identity groups; 773 development, 194 final; 12 prespecified targets; 49 non-overlapping Sanger groups for transfer. The primary trial is a self-run author test, not an independent newcomer trial. Findings are computational research hypotheses only.

assumptions.statement: Independent computational and scientific review has not occurred.
Release-provided screen processing is not refitted separately for each prediction fold.
Candidate-specific novelty remains unestablished; literature-based pairs are known controls.
The initial test has been inspected. Future adaptive contributions require new confirmation data.
No rule has both adequate two-branch support and a positive 95% external skill interval in the 49-group transfer cohort.

reproduce_full: .venv/bin/python src/benchmark.py develop --out research/replay && .venv/bin/python src/benchmark.py finalize --out research/replay && .venv/bin/python src/trial.py develop --out research/trial-replay && .venv/bin/python src/trial.py finalize --out research/trial-replay && .venv/bin/python src/compare_replay.py research/initial research/replay && .venv/bin/python src/compare_replay.py research/contributor-trial research/trial-replay

metric.name: Primary trial held-out normalized MSE skill versus frozen one-feature rules
